question: July Inflation US - Annual
resolution_criteria:
This is a market about inflation over the 12-month period ending July 2026, before seasonal adjustment, as reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

This market will resolve to the percentage change in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the 12-month period ending in July 2026 according to the monthly Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) report.

The resolution source for this market will be the BLS Consumer Price Index report released for July 2026 (https://www.bls.gov/bls/news-release/cpi.htm), currently scheduled to be released on August 12, 2026, at 8:30 AM ET. Resolution of this market will take place upon release of the aforementioned data.

Note: the resolution source for this market will be the official monthly BLS CPI news release, which reports inflation over 12-month periods to only one decimal point (e.g., 2.9%). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

If the BLS does not release the relevant figures on the scheduled date, this market may remain open up until the scheduled release time of the next CPI report (https://www.bls.gov/schedule). If the information is not released by that time, this market will resolve according to the figures of the most recent previous month with available data.

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
**Summary:** June CPI (released July 14) was +3.5% year over year, not seasonally adjusted. Holding the index unchanged in July would give about 3.4%. The bucket boundaries are close together (each is roughly 0.1 percentage point of July month-over-month change), so the July gasoline average is the main thing that will decide the result.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-07-14: The BLS June 2026 CPI release gave all-items CPI-U at **+3.5% over 12 months, not seasonally adjusted** (May was 4.2%). Seasonally adjusted, the index fell 0.4% in June, the largest monthly drop since April 2020. Not seasonally adjusted, it fell 0.3%. The unadjusted index was 333.952 in June 2026, versus 335.123 in May 2026 and 322.561 in June 2025. [BLS June release](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/cpi_07142026.htm); [BLS TED](https://www.bls.gov/opub/ted/2026/consumer-prices-up-3-5-percent-over-the-year-ended-june-2026.htm)
- 2026-07-14: Other June details: energy -5.7% seasonally adjusted and +15.7% year over year; gasoline -9.7% seasonally adjusted and +26.7% year over year; food +3.0% year over year; core 0.0% for the month and +2.6% year over year. The July CPI is scheduled for **Wednesday, 2026-08-12, 8:30 AM ET**. [BLS](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/cpi_07142026.htm)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The July figure has not been released as of 2026-07-23.
- My own calculation, which you should check: the July 2025 unadjusted CPI-U was about 323.048. On that basis, the July 2026 unadjusted month-over-month change needed for each bucket is roughly:
  - ≤3.1%: about -0.12% or lower
  - 3.2%: -0.12% to -0.02%
  - **3.3%: -0.02% to +0.07%**
  - **3.4%: +0.07% to +0.17%**
  - **3.5%: +0.17% to +0.27%**
  - 3.6%: +0.27% to +0.36%
  - 3.7%: +0.36% to about +0.46%
- An unchanged unadjusted index gives about 3.38%, at the top of the 3.3% bucket.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-20: GasBuddy put the national average at **$3.95/gal**, up 13.0 cents in a week (so about $3.82 on July 13), up 6.5 cents from a month earlier (about $3.89), and up 85.7 cents from a year earlier. Diesel was $5.077. [WSET/GasBuddy](https://wset.com/news/local/average-gasoline-prices-in-virginia-have-risen-in-the-last-week-gasbuddy-july-20-2026)
- Mid-July: Velera's July report gave gasoline at $3.86 on July 14. It also said tensions with Iran had re-escalated after President Trump declared the ceasefire off. [Velera PDF](https://res.cloudinary.com/drlz1sm4h/image/upload/v1784840173/Velera_Payments_Index_JULY_26_web_c53381d095.pdf)
- 2026-07-06: The national gas average had stayed below $4 for several weeks. [ENGIE](https://resources.engie-na.com/?p=12402)
- Late June: GasBuddy forecast about $3.75/gal for July 4 as a US-Iran deal cooled prices. AAA reported $3.91 on June 25. [ABC6](https://abc6onyourside.com/news/local/gasbuddy-forecasts-375-july-4-gas-in-2026-as-us-iran-deal-cools-prices)
- **What this means for July gasoline:** prices were lower in early July (about $3.75 to $3.86) and rose late in the month to about $3.95. The July average therefore looks roughly flat to slightly below June's average of about $3.9, before seasonal factors.

## 4. Base rates
- July unadjusted month-over-month changes in all-items CPI-U in recent years were about +0.19% (2023), +0.12% (2024) and +0.15% (2025), from memory of BLS data, so treat them as approximate. In normal years that range points to about 3.4% to 3.5%.
- 2026 seasonally adjusted monthly changes: Jan +0.2, Feb +0.3, Mar +0.9, Apr +0.6, May +0.5, Jun -0.4. Volatility is high because of energy. [BLS](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/cpi_07142026.htm)
- Year-over-year path: 4.2% in May, then 3.5% in June, a 0.7 percentage point move in one month. Moves of ±0.1 to 0.3 points in a month are common in this energy-driven period.
- Core monthly change was 0.0% in June. A rebound to the usual +0.2 to 0.3% would add pressure.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Cleveland Fed nowcast for July 2026, from secondary snapshots: the 07/03 vintage had headline -0.22% month over month (core 0.23). The 07/09 vintage had 3.71% year over year. Both predate the June release, and I could not find vintages from July 14 to 22. [Cleveland Fed](https://www.clevelandfed.org/indicators-and-data/inflation-nowcasting)
- Philadelphia Fed Survey of Professional Forecasters: median headline CPI of 3.0% annualized for Q3 2026 (cited in the Velera report). [Velera](https://res.cloudinary.com/drlz1sm4h/image/upload/v1784840173/Velera_Payments_Index_JULY_26_web_c53381d095.pdf)
- Kalshi has a July year-over-year market ([KXCPIYOY-26JUL](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxcpiyoy/inflation/kxcpiyoy-26jul)), but I could not get pre-close prices dated on or before July 23. I found no Polymarket or Manifold prices.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Gasoline prices for the rest of July, with Iran escalation risk after the ceasefire collapse. The July 20 to 31 prices affect the July average.
- Weekly gasoline data from EIA, AAA and GasBuddy, and updates to the Cleveland Fed nowcast through early August.
- Economist previews in the week before the release, then the BLS release on 2026-08-12 at 8:30 AM ET. A government data disruption could delay it, which would trigger the fallback rule.
